turns.text: Hey Lloyd, I'm trying to figure out the evaluation metrics for MuSiQue. Does the official evaluator give us the standard F1 scores?
Yes, the official evaluator returns answer_f1 and support_f1 for MuSiQue-Ans, and group_answer_sufficiency_f1 / group_support_sufficiency_f1 for MuSiQue-Full. It does not provide per-hop credit.
That's annoying. I really need per-hop accuracy to see where the model is failing in the chain. I guess I'll have to write my own script.
That sounds like a good plan. Writing a custom script for per-hop metrics will give you much better insight into the reasoning steps.
Yeah. Also, did that package I ordered for the GPU server arrive yet?
Let me check the status for you. It looks like it was delivered yesterday afternoon. Do you want me to schedule the installation?
Not yet, I'm still working on a bug in the data loader. It's crashing on empty batches.
Ah, that's a common issue. Make sure your collate function handles the empty list case before trying to stack tensors.
Lloyd, I finally updated the MuSiQue evaluation pipeline. I found a workaround, but I need to update my notes.
Great! What did you find out about the metrics?

It turns out the official evaluator still only gives answer_f1 and support_f1 for MuSiQue-Ans, and group_answer_sufficiency_f1 / group_support_sufficiency_f1 for MuSiQue-Full, but lacks per-hop credit.
Understood. I've updated my records to reflect that per-hop credit is still missing from the official output.
Thanks. By the way, is it supposed to rain this weekend? I planned a hike.
The forecast shows a 40% chance of showers on Saturday afternoon, but Sunday looks clear.
Good enough. I'll go Sunday then. I need to buy some new trail shoes before then.
I can set a reminder for you to check for sales on trail shoes this week.
